questions.stem: A bioterrorism attack is suspected in a large urban area where several individuals present with sudden-onset dyspnea, fever, and hemoptysis. Autopsy of deceased individuals reveals hemorrhagic mediastinitis. Which of the following best differentiates the causative pathogen from other spore-forming gram-positive rods?

options.label: A
options.text: Production of lecithinase and gas gangrene

options.label: B
options.text: Motility and presence of tumbling movement

options.label: C
options.text: Non-hemolytic growth with a "Medusa head" colony appearance
